message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Brad has confirmed that there are no 30-minute slots where all four partners are free. He has proposed a new strategy: find slots that work for at least three partners. This is a good idea to move forward. He has assigned me the task of finding slots for two combinations: (Priya, Marcus, and Elena) and (Priya, Marcus, and David). To do this, I need to know Elena's and David's availability. Brad has not provided me with their calendars, which I need to complete my assigned task. I will ask Brad to provide me with the calendars for Elena and David.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

function.arguments: {"text":"Hi Brad. Good idea to look for 3-person slots. To do my part, I'll need to see Elena's and David's calendars. Can you please share their free times with me?"}
